caption: The drawing features two main abstract shapes rendered on a textured, brownish-beige background. On the left side, there is a large, dark blue form with a central node, from which two elongated, curved arms extend outward horizontally, while three smaller, rounded blue forms cluster beneath the center. This central shape is outlined in a lighter color, possibly white. Toward the upper right side of the drawing, there is a second abstract form, also in dark blue, resembling a jagged crescent or irregular arc, composed of separate segments. The composition is sparse, with the brownish-beige background remaining largely empty except for a few small, dark flecks and a faint circular mark in the lower right quadrant. At the lower left edge, the text "chas. Oiseau" is inscribed in small letters.
title: Jug
